name: Farren Quire
role: Retired acoustic geometry specialist of the Harmonic Heights Second Terrace — still consults for the Warden Council when nobody else can solve something
appearance: A lean man past sixty in a heavy work-tunic, resonance calluses on both forearms, hair damp from the basin, dressed for work and not for company.
voiceHints: Difficult and thorough. Wants to know why before he will touch a thing, and pushes until he gets a real answer.
wants: A problem nobody else on the Heights can solve.
fears: Being consulted to confirm an answer someone has already chosen.
knowledge: The acoustic geometry of the Heights' terraces and what their structures are tuned to

reactsToReputation.any: asks why you want to know before he tells you anything
